datasets.title: Global Human Settlement Layer - population (GHS-POP) - Mollweide 100 m
datasets.description: GHS-POP in Mollweide coordinates and a spatial resolution of 100 meters. Climate scenarios (as published): "extrapolation" [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the STAC catalog climate-risk-stac (https://climate-risk-data.github.io/climate-risk-stac/)]
datasets.purpose: GHS-POP may underestimate population in sparsely populated locations where settlements are not detected by the satellite; it may therefore overconcentrate population in those locations where settlements are detected.

lineage.description: The Global Human Settlement Layer Population (GHS-POP) datasets are available in two different coordinate systems and two spatial resolutions each for the years 1975-2030 in 5-year time intervals.
